blockers.description: Dirty tree contains unrelated Golem, Elixir, AU wrapper, recon, docs, and .pi-subagents work.
blockers.workaround: Stage explicit Phase 10.2 paths only; never stage .pi-subagents/.

decisions: Technique/image preset titles; artist names are references, not imitation claims.
Research scopes works and periods, career evolution, persistent versus period traits, temporal movement, distinguishing vocabulary, and caricatures to avoid.
Exactly three independent reports plus a parent synthesis are required before activation.
Preset apply preserves tonic, tempo, devices, routing, sound, master level, mute/solo, plugins, and transport state.
Temporal behavior uses reusable Companion Lanes; stateless pitch mapping uses shared harmony strategies.
Pixel Trio uses two generic declarative PatternLane roles; no preset-specific Rust scheduling branch is allowed.
Stop after the first 12 for user testing.
The user explicitly approved continuing Loop 1 on 2026-07-20; Wave 3 is open.
Use only openai-codex/gpt-5.6-sol for research and all other subagent work.
Cloister Organum is a bounded two-voice Dorian P4/P5/P8 mapping, not an authentic organum reconstruction.
The July 19 guitar worker move exposed opt-level 0 throughput in Tauri dev; 7aca7ca optimizes only contrapunk-audio rather than changing detector thresholds.
